channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Two drones crash in Nato country after crossing from Russia
item.description: Two drones crashed in a NATO country after crossing from Russia. The incident occurred amid ongoing tensions related to the Ukraine war. Authorities have not disclosed the exact location or cause of the crash.

item.title: Jittery Milan host Atalanta with top-four spot under threat
item.description: AC Milan hosts Atalanta with their top-four spot in the Serie A standings under threat. The match is crucial for Milan's position. A win would help secure their spot. Jittery Milan host Atalanta with top-four spot under threat.

item.title: Australian Women and Children Linked to ISIS Fighters Return Home
item.description: Four Australian women and nine children linked to ISIS fighters returned home from detention camps in northeast Syria after a year-long controversy over their fate. The group's arrival marks the end of a long-standing debate over their repatriation.

item.title: Starmer Braces for Local Election Losses Amid New Era of UK Politics
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Labour Party faces predicted historic losses in local elections due to gains by Reform U. K. The results may signal a shift towards multiparty politics in the UK.

item.title: U.S. Awaits Iran’s Response to Latest Peace-Talks Proposal
item.description: The US is awaiting Iran's response to a latest peace-talks proposal. The development is part of ongoing diplomatic efforts to address tensions between the two nations. No details on Iran's stance have been released yet.

item.title: PSG’s Champions League win marred by night of violence and riots in Paris
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain's 6-5 Champions League semifinal win over Bayern Munich was marred by violence and riots in Paris. The incident occurred after the match. Domestic trouble erupted in the city.

item.title: Police report 3 dead in shooting in Linz, say no further danger to public
item.description: Three people died in a shooting in Linz, Austria, according to police. The gunfire was reported in the north of the city. Police stated there was no ongoing threat to the public.

item.title: South Africa condemns 'fake videos' of alleged xenophobic attacks
item.description: South Africa condemned 'fake videos' of alleged xenophobic attacks as claims of xenophobia mount. Ghana called on the African Union to send a fact-finding mission. Tensions rise in the region.

item.title: Chad declares national mourning after deadly Boko Haram ambush
item.description: Chad has declared national mourning after a Boko Haram ambush near Lake Chad killed two generals. The attack follows a recent Boko Haram assault in the same region that left dozens dead.

item.title: Russia To Enter New Conflict After Ukraine, Iran? NATO Nation Threatened
item.description: Russia has threatened to enter a new conflict after Ukraine and Iran, warning it will not spare any NATO nation. The statement comes amid rising tensions in the region. ‘Won’t Spare Even One’: Russia To Enter New Conflict After Ukraine, Iran?

item.title: Somali pirates abandon hijacked UAE dhow due to dwindling supplies
item.description: Somali pirates have abandoned a hijacked UAE dhow due to dwindling supplies. The Fahad-4, used as a mothership to attack other ships, was left adrift in the Indian Ocean. The lemon-laden Fahad-4, hijacked in late April, was used as a mothership to attack other ships.

item.title: Al-Qaeda-linked fighters in Mali set fire to food trucks
item.description: Al-Qaeda-linked fighters in Mali have set fire to food trucks as they continue to blockade roads around the capital Bamako. The blockade has disrupted food supplies in the city. Al-Qaeda-linked fighters have set fire to food trucks as they continue to blockade roads around the capital Bamako, cutt.

item.title: Ivory Coast dissolves electoral body amid criticism
item.description: Ivory Coast has dissolved its electoral body amid criticism of its lack of independence. A new agency will oversee elections, but its name has yet to be announced. New agency yet to be named to oversee elections after disbanded commission accused of not being independent.

item.title: Amid Middle East conflict, ASEAN countries eye more coordinated response to future crises
item.description: ASEAN plans to launch a contingency plan for future crises, including emergency fuel sharing and upholding freedom of navigation. The move comes as the region monitors the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Parliament passes Bill to allow companies to dual list on SGX, Nasdaq at the same time
item.description: Singapore's Parliament passed a Bill allowing companies to dual list on the SGX and Nasdaq. Members raised concerns about firms maintaining liquidity after listing on the Global Listing Board. Members of Parliament raised concerns on the ability for firms to maintain liquidity after listing on the Global Listing Board.

item.title: Bangladesh seeks China’s support in Teesta river restoration project
item.description: Bangladesh seeks China's support for the Teesta river restoration project. Details of the proposed project and China's response are not specified. Bangladesh seeks China’s support in Teesta river restoration project.

item.title: China announces suspended death sentences for former defence ministers
item.description: China announced suspended death sentences for former defence ministers. The move follows the recent ousting of several top officials in China's military. The announcement follows recent ousting of several top officials in China's military.

item.title: Three women linked to Islamic State arrested in Australia on return from Syria
item.description: Three women linked to the Islamic State were arrested in Australia after returning from Syria. They allegedly supported IS and were detained upon their first return to Australia in years.

item.title: Two Singapore Residents Isolated, Awaiting Hantavirus Test Results
item.description: Two Singapore residents isolated with suspected hantavirus after being on a cruise ship with confirmed cases. They are awaiting test results for the rare respiratory disease at a Singapore facility.

item.title: Russia says Ukraine launched a major drone attack after Moscow shunned ceasefire offer
item.description: Russia claims Ukraine launched a major drone attack after Moscow rejected a ceasefire offer. The incident increases tension as Russia's Victory Day celebrations near. Tension has grown as Russia's Victory Day celebrations approach and U. S.-led peace efforts gain no traction.
